title: Health Opportunity: What a Neighborhood Makes Easier or Harder

callouts.label: Food Access
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents food access.
callouts.description: Distance, price, quality, hours, and transportation shape food access.
callouts.ap_tip: Choice depends on available options. Local stores and markets can be community assets.

callouts.label: Recreation Space
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents recreation space.
callouts.description: Safe, welcoming places make movement and connection easier.
callouts.ap_tip: Quality and accessibility matter, not just presence. Programming can expand who feels included.

callouts.label: Transportation
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents transportation.
callouts.description: Reliable transit connects people with school, work, food, care, and community.
callouts.ap_tip: Time and cost are health factors. Routes should work for varied mobility needs.

callouts.label: Healthcare
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents healthcare.
callouts.description: Nearby care is useful only when it is affordable, respectful, accessible, and available.
callouts.ap_tip: Trust and language access matter. School and community services can reduce gaps.

callouts.label: Air Quality
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents air quality.
callouts.description: Traffic and industry can concentrate air pollution in some neighborhoods.
callouts.ap_tip: Exposure is shaped by policy and land use. Monitoring and clean-air action can reduce risk.

callouts.label: Traffic Safety
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents traffic safety.
callouts.description: Road design affects walking, wheeling, cycling, and injury risk.
callouts.ap_tip: Crossings, lighting, speed, and sidewalks matter. Safe design benefits everyone.

callouts.label: Housing Quality
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents housing quality.
callouts.description: Stable, safe housing supports sleep, study, stress regulation, and health.
callouts.ap_tip: Mold, heat, crowding, and displacement can cause harm. Housing conditions are public-health issues.

callouts.label: Affordability
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents affordability.
callouts.description: Costs for housing, food, care, and transportation compete within a budget.
callouts.ap_tip: Financial strain can affect stress and choices. Policy and community supports change what is possible.

callouts.label: Disability Access
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents disability access.
callouts.description: Ramps, curb cuts, surfaces, signage, and inclusive design affect participation.
callouts.ap_tip: Access should be designed in, not added as a favor. Universal design helps many users.

callouts.label: Schools
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents schools.
callouts.description: Schools can connect students with learning, meals, activity, care, and belonging.
callouts.ap_tip: Resources vary across communities. Student voice can improve school health.

callouts.label: Work and Time
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents work and time.
callouts.description: Work schedules and travel time affect sleep, meals, caregiving, and healthcare.
callouts.ap_tip: Time is a resource. Flexible policies can improve wellbeing.

callouts.label: Community Garden
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents community garden.
callouts.description: Gardens can support food, knowledge, culture, nature, and connection.
callouts.ap_tip: They do not replace systemic food access. Community ownership matters.

callouts.label: Green Space
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents green space.
callouts.description: Trees and nature can support cooling, cleaner air, movement, and restoration.
callouts.ap_tip: Maintenance and safety affect use. Green investment should avoid displacing residents.

callouts.label: Community Organization
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents community organization.
callouts.description: Residents hold knowledge and organize solutions that fit local needs.
callouts.ap_tip: Participation requires time, access, and power. Partnerships should share decisions.

callouts.label: Civic Decisions
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents civic decisions.
callouts.description: Budgets, zoning, transportation, and environmental rules shape health opportunity.
callouts.ap_tip: Disparities are not accidents of individual behavior. Civic action can change conditions.
